newsitem.title: USA: Polaris EPS seen rising -- report.
newsitem.headline: Polaris EPS seen rising -- report.

text.p: Polaris Industries Inc, despite the recent fall in its share price, is still set for earnings growth, according to an investor quoted in Barron's financial weekly.
Archie MacAllaster of MacAllaster Pitfield and MacKay told the paper he expects Polaris to earn close to $2.45 a share this year, compared to $2.19 last year, and possibly $2.60-2.65 in 1997.
Polaris dropped to a 52-week low of 23 last week after the company said retail sales of personal watercraft for the eight months through August fell eight percent.
However, MacAllaster said he doesn't plan to sell any Polaris stock, citing the company's soundness and its dividends, the paper reported.
